operating_notes.text: Softcrylic LLC merged into Hexaware Technologies Inc effective May 1, 2026 with no cash consideration.
113,958 equity shares were issued during the quarter ended March 31, 2026 on exercise of employee stock options.
Q1CY26 revenue was $388.5 Mn, down 0.1% QoQ and up 4.6% YoY; constant currency fell 0.3% QoQ.
Top 10 customers contributed 35.9% of revenue in Q1CY26, down from 36.4% in Q4CY25.
Utilization rate for IT was 82.6% in Q1CY26, up from 80.8% in Q4CY25.
Acquisition of CPS Holdings and its subsidiary via Hexaware Technologies UK Ltd for GBP 11 Mn
Hexaware introduced governance, development, and lifecycle management enhancements to its enterprise AI agent platform, Agentverse™.
Hexaware partnered with HBSUK to implement a workforce management system on Journey36's App36 platform supported by Axonyx.ai.
Closing headcount stood at 35,887 with voluntary attrition for IT at 11.1%.
Total headcount reached 35,887 with IT voluntary attrition at 11.1% and IT utilization at 84.9%.

timeline.summary: Hexaware Technologies declared a first interim dividend of ₹8.50 per share for FY26 and appointed Mr. Neeraj Bharadwaj to the Stakeholders Relationship Committee.
Hexaware Technologies announced the merger of its wholly owned US subsidiary Softcrylic LLC into Hexaware Technologies Inc effective May 1, 2026.
Hexaware Technologies Limited’s 33rd AGM on May 05, 2026, approved financial statements and interim dividends with 99.9974% and 99.7299% shareholder votes respectively.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹3,613 Cr (+12.6% YoY), net profit ₹351.6 Cr (+7.5% YoY).

Hexaware Q1CY26 (quarter ended March 31, 2026): revenue ₹3,613 Cr (+12.6% YoY), EBIT margin 13.0% (-133 bps YoY), reported profit ₹351.6 Cr (+7.5% YoY); reiterated CY26 revenue growth of 7.6% and EBIT margin of 13.0%-14.0%.
Hexaware updates on legal case against European client with insolvency proceedings in Germany and US recognition
2026-05-13: Hexaware received favorable appellate order setting aside ₹15.13 Cr GST demand for FY20-21
2026-05-20: Hexaware approved acquisition of CPS Holdings and its subsidiary via UK arm for GBP 11 Mn
Hexaware Technologies announced new enhancements to its enterprise AI agent platform, Agentverse™, on June 2, 2026.
Hexaware announced a partnership with UK-based HBSUK on June 3, 2026, to enhance clinician onboarding efficiency using cloud and AI platforms.
Board of Directors, led by **Gunjan Methi**, will vote on the 2nd interim dividend for FY2026 via circular resolution on October 20, 2026.
2026-10-20: Board declared 2nd interim dividend of ₹9.50 per share for FY2026
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹3,933.1 Cr (+12.9% YoY), net profit ₹429.4 Cr (+16.1% YoY).
Hexaware Technologies reported Q3CY26 revenue of ₹3,933.1 Cr (+12.9% YoY) and net profit of ₹429.4 Cr, alongside an investor presentation.
